messages:
ana: Heads up — SA region GPU warm pool failed to reach target this morning, a bunch of nodes stuck in PROVISIONING and warmup times spiked.
matt: seeing the same, jobs queueing. any obvious errors in kube or keystore?
sre-bot: Alert: warm-pool-size < target for pool=sa-gpu-prod (detected 1719009900)
sre-bot: Recent spike in NATGW conntrack and flowlogs ingestion for SA region.
ana: (typo) ana: quick dump from node-controller: 
```
I040 10:12:03 node-controller.go:112] Provisioning node i-0a...defer: KeystoreDecryptError: KMS Decrypt failed: AccessDenied
```
Looks like keystore decrypts failing intermittently.
matt: AccessDenied on KMS usually points to role boundary / key policy change. any IAM rollout recently?
divya: Security pushed a tighter key policy yesterday to restrict cross-account decrypts. That would break autoscaler if node IAM role isn't in policy.
oliver: We can't relax the policy without approval — compliance needs the audit sampling increase. But this is taking customer-facing capacity down.
ana: ana: short-term proposal: add a fallback that lets warm-pool use an ephemeral provisioning key (scoped, short TTL) until we fix IAM bindings. Prep PR to generate ephemeral key via KMS with limited decrypt rights.
security-bot: Suggested: open a temporary exception for agent-role@sa-account to decrypt keystore until EOD, log all decrypts, notify compliance.
matt: Ops mitigation that doesn't touch key policy: route keystore traffic through privatelink in SA region so KMS call goes via VPC endpoint (reduces NATGW conntrack and stops hitting egress proxies).
divya: Privatelink helps traffic path but still needs key policy change or cross-account grant unless we mint ephemeral key in the same account.
oliver: Cost tradeoffs — privatelink + endpoints adds $/month and infra work, ephemeral keys add operational complexity. Which is lower risk short-term?
ana: My vote: ephemeral provisioning key for warm-pool + enable privatelink as medium-term. That buys hours to coordinate security review.
matt: I'll draft k8s patch to let warm-pool use fallback key. snippet: 
```
apiVersion: autoscaling/v1
kind: ScalePolicy
metadata:
  name: warm-pool-sa
spec:
  minReadySeconds: 180
  fallbackKeystore: kms://ephemeral/sa-warmpool
```

(more pseudo)

matt: also increasing warm-pool min to reduce churn: from 20 -> 30 nodes for next 2 hours.
divya: filing request with security to approve ephemeral key and add audit hook. pinging @security for emergency review :point_up:
security-bot: Raised ticket SEQ-4721 for emergency key exception; requested logs and TTL <= 1h.
ana: I'll do the PR and manual rollout to sa warm pool in canary. i'll post status updates here. :rocket:
oliver: once stable we need postmortem: timeline, what caused IAM mismatch, why audit sampling change created NATGW pressure, estimated cost impact of privatelink vs fallback.
matt: noted. will capture metrics: prewarm fail rate, provisioning latency, NATGW conntrack, KMS 403 rate.
ana: update: PR merged to canary, starting manual uplift now. will report in ~10m.
matt: thanks — monitoring dashboards pinned.
ana: 10m update: canary warm-pool nodes came up, decrypts succeeded with ephemeral key, SA pool backfilling. rolling to full pool in 5m. :thumbsup:
security-bot: Exception approved until 02:00 UTC, TTL enforced, audit hook enabled.
odiver: (typo) oliver: thx all. follow-up doc please on recommended long-term fix.
ana: will draft postmortem and cost comparison (privatelink vs ephemeral operational overhead) — assigning to me + matt + divya.
